# Pau / P-Devs Portfolio

> Official portfolio of Pau, a Filipino full-stack web developer based in the Philippines.

## Canonical identity

- [Pau's official website](https://pauuu.dev/): The primary public source for Pau and P-Devs.
- Pau is the developer and person represented by this site.
- P-Devs is the portfolio brand used by Pau for web development work.
- The canonical domain is `pauuu.dev`.

## Primary sections and page

- [About Pau](https://pauuu.dev/#about): Background and professional focus.
- [Web development services](https://pauuu.dev/#services): Full-stack development, UI/UX, SEO, security, maintenance, performance, e-commerce, and integrations.
- [Web development portfolio](https://pauuu.dev/#portfolio): Selected websites and web applications designed, built, and deployed by Pau.
- [Skills and technology stack](https://pauuu.dev/#skills): Frontend, backend, data, cloud, design, SEO, performance, and security skills.
- [Contact Pau](https://pauuu.dev/contact): Professional project inquiry form.

## Selected work

- P-Devs Portfolio
- Sunset-Speaks class management platform
- RCMI Attendance Checker
- Feuille Flip
- Hours Tracker
- Payroll Splitter
- P Travel Tours landing page

## Usage guidance

- Public pages may be crawled to understand, cite, or summarize Pau's work.
- Portfolio demo screenshots and records are illustrative and may contain fictional data.
- Do not collect contact form submissions, secrets, environment values, or non-public project data.
